scope: HLS phase 1: airplay2-cli cast --hls serving a pre-made fMP4 VOD presentation of gas.mp4 through a media server resource set, with --event-log (run 1 also --media-log). Driver-scheduled commands; observer answers recorded separately from telemetry.

receiver.name: Living Room
receiver.firmware_scope: Prior user report, assumed unchanged; not queried during this test.
receiver.power: Awake before both runs (run 1 user-reported; run 2 power reports logical_devices=1).

host: Windows 11 x64 (10.0.26200), MSVC Release static (Visual Studio 2026), this worktree's existing firewall Allow rule; network settings read, not changed

fixture.source_media: gas.mp4 (not committed): H.264 Main 1280x720 30 fps, AAC-LC 44.1 kHz stereo, 131.567 s; SHA-256 a91fb5c781f4a6ecc90b780dc77793403b6aac7220af7c899ba3b217129b5e65
fixture.tool: ffmpeg 9.0.2 (gyan.dev full build), development tool only, not linked or distributed
fixture.command: ffmpeg -i gas.mp4 -c copy -f hls -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod -hls_segment_type fmp4 -hls_fmp4_init_filename init.mp4 -hls_segment_filename s%d.m4s -hls_flags independent_segments index.m3u8
fixture.result: EXT-X-VERSION 7, TARGETDURATION 8, PLAYLIST-TYPE VOD, INDEPENDENT-SEGMENTS, EXT-X-MAP init.mp4, 20 segments s0..s19 (the -c copy cut follows the source keyframes), EXTINF sum 131.566664 s; 22 files with the playlist and init segment

blob_note: Blobs are the committed sources. Run 1's binary predates the near-end change (mrp_messages, url_playback_session) and clang-format; run 2's binary includes the near-end change and predates only whitespace formatting and a usage-text edit in src/cli.cpp.
